name.zh-CN: 载板 ALSA 音频（ES8326B 编解码器）

note.en: Verified inventory for the X5 MD V1.2 reference-carrier setup; custom carriers may differ. Linux exposes playback and capture on the duplexaudio sound card; headphones and a microphone are external. The current X5 BSP does not register an SDK audio device, and recording/playback have not been validated.
note.zh-CN: 以下为 X5 MD V1.2 配套参考载板组合的设备信息，自定义载板可能不同。Linux 的 duplexaudio 声卡提供播放与采集设备，耳机、麦克风需要外接。当前 X5 BSP 未注册 SDK 音频设备，录音、播放尚未验证。

name.zh-CN: 载板 ACT 状态指示灯

note.en: Verified inventory for the X5 MD V1.2 reference-carrier setup; custom carriers may differ. Linux LED-class device: /sys/class/leds/ACT, with the heartbeat trigger by default. This is separate from the power indicators; the current X5 BSP does not register an SDK LED, and application control has not been validated.
note.zh-CN: 以下为 X5 MD V1.2 配套参考载板组合的设备信息，自定义载板可能不同。Linux LED 类设备路径为 /sys/class/leds/ACT，默认使用 heartbeat 心跳触发器，与电源指示灯分开。当前 X5 BSP 未注册 SDK LED，应用控制尚未验证。

name.zh-CN: 载板 Sleep / 唤醒按键

note.en: Verified inventory for the X5 MD V1.2 reference-carrier setup; custom carriers may differ. Linux gpio-keys reports KEY_WAKEUP (143); locate its /dev/input/event* node by device name. This is not the keyboard 's' trigger; the current X5 BSP does not register an SDK button, and key handling has not been validated.
note.zh-CN: 以下为 X5 MD V1.2 配套参考载板组合的设备信息，自定义载板可能不同。Linux gpio-keys 上报 KEY_WAKEUP（143），按设备名称定位 /dev/input/event* 节点。这不是键盘 s 触发键；当前 X5 BSP 未注册 SDK 按键，事件处理尚未验证。
